name: aurex
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Aurex instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Aurex tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Aurex through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Aurex Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Aurex only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
